description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, Workhorse gain persist until end of turn.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 2 until Workhorse dies.
Dross Scorpion and Workhorse triggers.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Workhorse persist ability trigger, returning it to the battlefield with three +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
